scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names "renderer,electron" --prefix-colors "cyan,yellow" "pnpm --filter @riacore/renderer dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 pnpm --filter @riacore/desktop-host exec electron dist/main.js"
scripts.build:core: pnpm --filter @riacore/git-service build && pnpm --filter @riacore/app-contracts build && pnpm --filter @riacore/importer-sdk build && pnpm --filter @riacore/sysml-language build && pnpm --filter @riacore/importer-arxml --filter @riacore/importer-sn --filter @riacore/importer-sysml-v2 --filter @riacore/importer-sysml-v2-textual build && pnpm --filter @riacore/app-core build && pnpm --filter @riacore/desktop-host --filter @riacore/cli build && pnpm clean:vite-cache
scripts.package:desktop:win: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @riacore/renderer build && pnpm --filter @riacore/desktop-host package:win
scripts.package:desktop:mac: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @riacore/renderer build && pnpm --filter @riacore/desktop-host package:mac
scripts.package:desktop:linux: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @riacore/renderer build && pnpm --filter @riacore/desktop-host package:linux
